description: Reified 'Name' collection (WP2.3): a group of related fields modelled as its own Subject.

Name.description: This field is used to record the string value of the name attributed to the documented entity.

Name Type.description: This field is used to record the type of the name attributed to the documented person.

Name Language.description: This field is used to record the language of the name attributed to the documented person.

Source Reference Work for Name.description: This field is used to link to a source text in which the name denoting the documented entity is used.
